item.title: Inokashira Park — Guide
item.description: Inokashira Park, in the fashionable suburb of Kichijoji in western Tokyo, is a beloved local park centred on a large, tree-fringed pond. A relaxed and lively place, it’s especially popular on weekends, with locals enjoying its natural setting, walking paths and easy-going atmosphere. The pond is famous for its swan-shaped pedal boats and rowing boats, a fun way to spend an afternoon on the water, and its cherry trees make it one of west Tokyo’s loveliest hanami spots in spring, their blossoms hanging over the water.
